description: This file defines schema-related data structures for Kubernetes API extensions, including schema representations, validation rules, and extensions.

classes.name: Structural
classes.description: Represents a Kubernetes structural schema with nested properties and validation extensions.

classes.name: StructuralOrBool
classes.description: A union type that can be either a Structural schema or a boolean.

classes.name: Generic
classes.description: Contains generic schema fields not used in value validation, such as description, type, default, and nullable.

classes.name: Extensions
classes.description: Holds Kubernetes-specific OpenAPI extensions like preserve unknown fields, embedded resources, and list/map types.

classes.name: ValidationExtensions
classes.description: Holds validation-specific extensions, including validation rules.

classes.name: ValueValidation
classes.description: Encapsulates validation constraints such as format, range, length, pattern, and enumerations.

classes.name: NestedValueValidation
classes.description: Validation schema used for nested structures, supporting recursive validation and extensions.

classes.name: JSON
classes.description: A wrapper for arbitrary JSON data with deep copy capabilities.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the JSON object.

methods.name: DeepCopyInto
methods.description: Copies the JSON object into another JSON instance.
